segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ מְסַכְּכִין בִּנְסָרִים, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי יְהוּדָה, וְרַבִּי מֵאִיר אוֹסֵר. נָתַן עָלֶיהָ נֶסֶר שֶׁהוּא רָחָב אַרְבָּעָה טְפָחִים — כְּשֵׁרָה, וּבִלְבַד שֶׁלֹּא יִישַׁן תַּחְתָּיו.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One» may «roof» the sukka «with boards» like those used in the ceiling of a house; this is «the statement of Rabbi Yehuda. Rabbi Meir prohibits» their use. «If one placed a board that is four handbreadths wide atop» the sukka, the sukka «is fit.» He fulfills his obligation, «provided he does not sleep beneath» the board.

moves.summary: R' Yehuda permits boards, R' Meir prohibits; a four-handbreadth board leaves the sukka fit if one does not sleep under it

edges.cueHe: דברי רבי יהודה, ורבי מאיר אוסר
edges.about: whether one may roof a sukka with boards

positions.claim: one may not roof with boards
a board four handbreadths wide placed on the sukka leaves it fit, provided one does not sleep beneath it
